why: “At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the Doctrina Imperatives” (Faction Pack v1.4 Rules Updates / Wahapedia): the start of the battle round is filed under Command with at:'Start of the battle round' shown, the settled convention (Da Boss, Wrathful Presence, Unearthly Power); the Imperatives' bullets name no phase.
The start of the battle round comes before either player's turn (Core Rules 07.01 “before progressing to player turns”), and the Imperative lasts “Until the end of the battle round”, so either turn.

“Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in LEGIO CYBERNETICA units from your army … add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit” (Faction Pack v1.4 Rules Updates): LEGIO CYBERNETICA picks only the Datasmith + Kastelan Robots unit here.

“unless that unit is Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit”; New Recruit prints OC 1 (Datasmith) and 2 (Kastelan Robot), the same as Wahapedia's base OC 1 and 2, so the +1 is not in them (its M 8" does include the +2").
WHEN: “Your Command phase.”
WHEN: “Your Command phase.”: your turn.

TARGET: “One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army”: Faction: Adeptus Mechanicus + Vehicle picks the Datasmith + Kastelan Robots (VEHICLE per the pack's Datasmith update), both Ironstrider units, the Onager and the Skorpius, and not Cawl, Thulia (MONSTER), the Enginseer or the Rangers.
“Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for it”: the gist says that, with its duration.
WHEN: “Your Command phase.”
WHEN: “Your Command phase.”: your turn.

TARGET: “One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit”: every LEGIO CYBERNETICA unit is Faction: Adeptus Mechanicus, so all:[Faction: Adeptus Mechanicus], any:[Legio Cybernetica, Vehicle] is the same set (here the Datasmith + Kastelans, Ironstriders ×2, Onager, Skorpius ×2).

The source says the weapons “can only target units within range of the selected objective marker”, a targeting restriction, but the footnote puts “only at units within range…” in the condition slot, so it reads as if BS 3+/[IGNORES COVER] apply only against those units and the unit can still shoot other units normally. It should be when:'Your Command phase, until the start of your next Command phase', note:'BS 3+, [IGNORES COVER]; can only target units within range of the selected objective marker'.

Word for word the FAQ in GW's Faction Pack (“FACTION PACK: VERSION 1.4”, Rules Updates, FAQS): “Q: If I target a unit with the Auto-divinatory Targeting Stratagem while the Protector Imperative is active for my army, in what order are the Ballistic Skill modifiers applied? A: The Ballistic Skill characteristic … is first changed to 3+ by the Stratagem, then improved by 1 by the Protector Imperative, for a final result of 2+ (assuming no other modifiers apply).” Wahapedia has the same words.
WHEN: “Your Command phase.”
WHEN: “Your Command phase.”: your turn.

Keyword part: “One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit”, written as for the other Cohort Cybernetica stratagems. Keywords can't express “that is below its Starting Strength”, and the app doesn't hide it: every footnote under the weapons reads “…, below its Starting Strength; until the start of your next Command phase” and the card's TARGET quotes it. The folded stratagem row (gist + unit list) doesn't mention it.

“each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If your unit is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well”, targeting a unit “below its Starting Strength”, until the start of your next Command phase: kind all, the condition and the duration are all there.

“Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If your unit is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.”: the gist says exactly that (the Starting Strength limit is TARGET text, not EFFECT text).
WHEN: “Your Command phase.”
WHEN: “Your Command phase.”: your turn.
TARGET: “One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army”: same keyword set as Auto-divinatory Targeting.

The source says “ignore any or all modifiers to its characteristics and/or to any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws)”, but the note drops “made for it”, so “to any roll or test” also covers rolls the opponent makes against the unit, which is more than the source allows. It should read note:'can ignore any or all modifiers to its characteristics and to any roll or test made for it (not saving throws)', or “to its rolls and tests”, as the gist puts it.

“If the Protector Imperative is active for that unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the Conqueror Imperative is active for that unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.”: kind all (every attack), both conditions kept, and like the source it is not optional.
